title: External Groundwater Adapter Conformance Capability Qualification

adversarial_review.finding: Initial green gate did not exercise the public direct candidate commit route or rebind while a prepared reservation was live.
adversarial_review.closure: Added direct commit failure/success coverage and active-prepared rebind rejection on the same capability branch.
adversarial_review.additional_finding: Batch rebind validated gateway quiescence only while mutating members sequentially, so a later non-quiescent member could reject after an earlier member had already been rebound.
adversarial_review.additional_closure: Preflight all gateway quiescence before the first batch mutation and add a regression that keeps both original cell bindings unchanged when a later member is prepared/non-quiescent.

workflow_efficiency.reason: GC26 qualification hashes current files and does not require historical refs; full-history checkout was unnecessary overhead.

hard_nonclaims: No concrete MODFLOW or other external groundwater model integration/release claim.
No groundwater-coupling-v1 end-to-end production completion claim.
No distributed crash-recovery guarantee after prepared publication begins.
Batch support here means multiple uniquely configured gateway instances sharing one backend; it does not claim one vectorized remote backend call.
No groundwater physics, Richards solver policy, mass tolerance or convergence tolerance was changed.
required_next_step: Independent adapter-conformance review/qualification and current-canonical admission review are required before promotion. Concrete external groundwater-model integration, if any, follows its own controlled fixture and release authority.
